info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect Actions Navigation API
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Navigation Menu Items

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: navigationLinkSetId
params.description: The ID of the navigation link set to retrieve

params.name: menuItemTypesToSkip
params.description: Comma-separated list of menu item types to exclude

params.name: publishStatus
params.description: Filter by publish status of the navigation menu

items.docs: Returns the navigation menu items configured for the specified Experience Cloud site. Includes menu labels, target URLs, access restrictions, and hierarchy structure.
